# Orange (an apricot-orange): a faceted ball 0.36 m across with a stalk.
# Origin at the fruit's centre (a game bone pool: the game drops, catches and pops it).
new
material new Body --base-color 0.8275 0.6275 0.4078 --no-slot
material new Stem --base-color 0.2941 0.2549 0.3451 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Fruit --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.18 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 1.0
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name Stalk --size 1 --location 0.02 0 0.230
scale 0.06 0.06 0.14
apply --scale
material assign Stem
select all
active Fruit
join
select all
shade flat
export orange.glb
